# Calculate seconds until 18:30 UTC today
now=$(date +%s)
target=$(date -d "today 18:30:00" +%s)

if [ "$now" -ge "$target" ]; then
  target=$(date -d "tomorrow 18:30:00" +%s)

echo "Target: $(date -d @$target)"
echo "Delay:  ${delay} seconds ($(($delay / 3600))h $((($delay % 3600) / 60))m)"

echo "Background PID: $!"
